description:
Immerse yourself and decide the course of the story! Meet a young English teacher who, although he is attracted to some of his students, strives to maintain his professionalism at all times. In this novel, the choices you make will have a direct impact on how relationships and situations develop in the classroom.
 
Will you follow a path of discipline and respect, or will you give in to the advances of the students? Full of twists and turns and exciting moments that are completely up to you - every choice counts and every ending will be different!
 
With multiple endings based on your decisions. Explore different paths. Make your story unique and discover what outcome awaits you!
name: Mr. Sensei: Life as a Foreign Teacher in Japan
intro: Decide the fate of a teacher! Every decision influences his relationships and leads to unique endings. Which will you choose?
